<?php
$qry = "SELECT f.body_value AS new_body
FROM {field_data_body} s
LEFT JOIN {field_data_body} f ON s.entity_id = f.entity_id
WHERE s.body_value = :intext
AND f.language = :outlang
LIMIT 1";

?>
